# Sample research brief (fixture for tests / dry runs)

### Development 1
- Headline: "Microsoft unveils new AI models to lessen reliance on OpenAI"
- Summary: Microsoft made its MAI model family available to developers to cut costs.
- Source: CNBC, 2 June 2026, https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/02/microsoft-unveils-new-ai-models-lessen-reliance-on-openai-lower-costs.html
- Category: Headline
- Why it matters: Signals model choice is becoming about cost and control, not just capability.

### Development 2
- Headline: "EU AI Act high-risk obligations enforceable 2 August 2026"
- Summary: High-risk system rules (Articles 9 to 17, Article 26) take effect.
- Source: Latham & Watkins, May 2026, https://www.lw.com/en/insights/ai-act-update-eu-resolves-to-change-rules-and-extend-deadlines
- Category: Regulation and governance
- Why it matters: Several client systems are in scope and need a conformity assessment.

### Development 3
- Headline: "Gartner holds 30% generative AI project abandonment forecast"
- Summary: Poor data quality and unclear value remain the main causes of failure.
- Source: Gartner, July 2024, https://www.gartner.com/en/newsroom/press-releases/2024-07-29-gartner-predicts-30-percent-of-generative-ai-projects-will-be-abandoned-after-proof-of-concept-by-end-of-2025
- Category: Proof point
- Why it matters: Failures are structural, which is where a short prototype helps.
